technical.summary: Early momentum crossovers (MACD, Stoch) with supertrend support, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud—confluence is mixed and lacks strong directional confirmation.

fundamental.summary: PLD shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, and minimal retail interest.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale vs 2 purchases, all small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (381.44), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions for real estate equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early MACD/Stoch crossovers with supertrend support and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) create a contrarian entry setup near support (99.27) with defined risk.
